verdict.rationale: The pack shows only that Jira can be extended with apps and that Forge provides demo sites for developing and testing apps. No evidence documents UI extension points for building custom views or dashboard widgets, or shows that such extensions render natively in the product. Generic app extensibility and Marketplace integrations are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
